description: Overlapping triggers: two order_placed events create independent obligations per rule (ack#o0/#o1, ship#o0/#o1, bill#o0/#o1). One early ack satisfies only ack#o0. One shipped with the wrong correlation value (o-2 vs pending o-1) resolves nothing; the correct shipped event at the boundary satisfies ship#o1 only. Earliest-deadline policy on bill_order: one invoiced event with an invoice satisfies only bill#o0; bill#o1 is sealed by the end marker.
